title: Eko Yettii Jappeere
intro: Limre teddunde ɓadtii jooɗorde ñaawoore ndee, daande maɓɓe ina diwa wonaa e kulol kono ko e yaakaare. Haala kaa ko huunde nde neɗɗo, kono tan, ƴeewndo maggo ina foti rewrude e sahaa, ina ustoo aada tooñannge. Hol ooɗoo ruuhu mo wullitaango mum nani haa caggal koode?
clues: Mi arii e ɓernde teddunde, miɗo ɗaɓɓa nuunɗal e haala kaɓɓunde ɗemngal am.
Ñaagunde am wonaa tan e nulaaɗo; ɗum ƴetti haa ɓurti, to nanoowo fof.
Konnguɗi ɗi kaaldaa e am ɗii ina nanndi e kaɓirɗe ɓooyɗe.
Miɗo haɓana miɗo miijoo, e gonɗi e logic, ngam ndimaagu am.
Wahyu jippii, muumɗini laabi ɓooyɗi ɗii, jaɓi mette am.
Ɓe mbiyata mi ko luutndiiɗo jom suudu am, innde am wonti ko nanndi e tonngoode rimɗinnde mi.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Debbo Imraan (Yumma Mariyam)
Debbo luurduɗo e gorko mum (Khawla bint Tha'laba)
Laamiiɗo debbo Saba (Bilqis)
Yumma mum Muusaa
Debbo Firaawna (Asiya) .
identity.answer: Debbo luurduɗo e gorko mum (Khawla bint Tha'laba)

trial.label: Ñaawoore ndee walla Kewu nguu
options: O tuumaama e fenaande wonde o jom laaɓal
O woniino ɓiɗɗo, omo yiɗi ɓiɗɗo
O fotnoo ko aada ceergal tooñoowo
Ko o laamɗo debbo kaaldigal e annabi
O suuɗii ɓiyiiko e jom doole en
trial.answer: O fotnoo ko aada ceergal tooñoowo

location.label: Elemen keyɗo

Jappeere mawnde

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: O barkiniraa ko ɓiɗɗo e nder mawngu makko
O hisnaama e ronkude ndiyam
O heɓi wahyu Alla ina momta aada oo
O wonti laamɗo debbo caggal jarribo
O hokkaama ɓiɗɗo gorko, laati annabi
outcome.answer: O heɓi wahyu Alla ina momta aada oo

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
